summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $85.3M from $48.7M.
The net loss widened to $78.5M, or −$5.90 per share, from $40.2M. Operating cash flow was −$64.5M and free cash flow −$64.5M, versus −$41.8M.
sources: Corbus Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
